logs: Fix done: 9/9 files · applied 65 · refused 26 · unclean 0

refused: 15: checker flags forbidden string '.agents/research' on the Evidence header line. It is pre-existing and not named by any finding. It anchors every relative evidence path in the ADR to the grimoire-lore research directory, and removing it would leave all cited paths unresolvable. Left unchanged for the orchestrator to decide.

other files: the checker also reports forbidden strings and broken links in nix-generated-flakes.md, index-data-model.md, oci-fetch-prototype.md, prototype/README.md, verification-rerun-w2.md and verification-rerun-w3.md. Those files are not mine to edit.

Its '&& fail=1' makes both blocking, which is what finding 6 (applied) removes. Its bracketed patterns and brace-only filter were applied through findings 3, 7 and 12.

49 (merge of findings 3, 7, 12): line 49 takes finding 7's filter (grep -v -e '[$]{{ secrets[.]' -e '[$]{{ github[.]token }}') with finding 3's broad pattern -e 'access-[t]okens'. Finding 7's 'access-[t]okens *=' / '--access-[t]okens' patterns miss the '--option access-tokens' run line, which finding 3 watched as a red case. Finding 12's line-49 variant and its after-block sentence are covered by finding 7's appended paragraph. Watched on a fixture: green carrier workflow (gate lines plus secrets/github.token feeds) exit 1 on both lines, red (accept-flake-config, README trusted-users, --option access-tokens) exit 0.
47 (finding 3 comment clause): superseded by finding 6's full replacement of line 47. The bracketed-letters explanation is in the paragraph appended after the gate block (finding 7).
not my file: rules/nix-quality/gates.md:177,179 need the --inputs-from . spelling (findings 2, 8, 11), and the gates.md security step needs the bracketed step-2a lines (finding 3)
not my file: rules/nix-quality/security.md:83 (and the NIX-SEC-02/03/08 greps near it) need the bracketed patterns and the [$]{{ filter (finding 3)
not my file: rules/nix-quality/flakes.md:56 and skills/nix-flake-adopt/SKILL.md:84 need the --inputs-from . spelling (finding 8)
not my file: check-artifacts.py reports 17 column-count findings in rules/nix-quality/packaging.md (lines 88-244, 6 unescaped '|' against a 7-column header)

179 (finding 8, other-file part): applied only the gates.md edits, the same as findings 1 and 2. The `--inputs-from . ` insertions at rules/nix-quality.md lines 58 and 60 and rules/nix-quality/flakes.md line 56 are outside my file and need that file's fixer.

32 (finding 14, 'Add to Applied' part): gates.md has no Applied section, and no other depth file has one, so there is no existing row shape to follow. The line-35 exception sentence is applied. The devshell flake.nix:94 and impermanence flake.nix:49 evidence rows are not added.
checker: 17 findings, all in rules/nix-quality/packaging.md (NIX-PKG-05..22 rows at lines 88-244 have unescaped '|'), none in gates.md.
finding 4 (language.md:185,193 portion): not my file (rules/nix-quality/language.md) — the inputs.md portion of finding 4 was applied, merged with finding 6

finding 5 (index line 56, gates.md line 147 portions): not my file — only the inputs.md line 57 condition string and Verification-cell append were applied; the index and gates.md copies still need the same fix

findings 1 and 6 both rewrite item 11's first clause with different exact wording for the same fact; applied once using finding 6's phrasing (fully covers finding 1's content: CppNix 2.20/Lix 2.95.2 wording vs CppNix 2.31.5/2.35.2 'access to absolute path')

findings 2 and 6 both append the same Lix-split fact to NIX-INP-04's Rationale cell; applied once (finding 2's fuller sentence, with the '-source' suffix) rather than duplicating the same addition twice

212 (partial): the agenix NIX-MOD-03 Applied row now points at modules/age-home.nix, not modules/age.nix. After finding 1, age.nix is exported as both nixos and darwin, so under the amended rule it is explicitly not a finding. age-home.nix is exported only as homeManagerModules, has no _class, and the per-file grep lists it (confirmed at the held-out clone). All Applied rows leave out repo@sha and the C-class codes, because shipped text carries no SHA and C-codes are not defined in shipped rules. I also added the new section to the Contents line.

72/61 (consistency): changed the MOD-03 Verification cell's reference from `grep -rL` to `grep -L` to match the rewritten command. Red/green watched on fixtures/fix-modules with GNU grep 3.12: the MOD-05, MOD-06 (new form, including `with lib.types; attrsOf path`), MOD-07 and per-file MOD-03 checks each hit on red and stay empty on green. On nixos-hardware over `.`, MOD-05 prints 13 lines. With the `nix` operand the exit code is 2. No Nix fence was touched.

rules/nix-quality/packaging.md: check-artifacts reports 17 column-count findings (NIX-PKG-05..22 rows, each with 6 unescaped '|' against a 7-column header). That is not my file, and the checker reports nothing in modules.md.

380 (finding 5): superseded by finding 1 at the same row. Row 8 now reads 'An exported overlay is written `self: super:`, `prev: final:` or with formals', which matches nix-flake-adopt row 2 word for word, so both findings are satisfied.

147 (finding 6, SKILL.md part): the line 147 fix is covered by finding 2's text. That text is the same command plus the IFD option, and it was watched on fix-nix-diagnose: a self: super: overlay exited 1 and final: _prev: exited 0, on nix 2.31.5 with the locked nixpkgs 26.11.20260926.e158d9e.

203 (finding 6, SKILL.md:203 nixf-diagnose): refused. `nix run --inputs-from . nixpkgs#nixf-diagnose -- flake.nix` evaluates the flake before the tool starts, so on a flake with an undefined variable (the case this tool exists for) it fails with nix's own `error: undefined variable 'y'` and nixf-diagnose never runs. This was watched on fix-nix-diagnose/undef. The unlocked form stays.

finding 6, other files: skills/nix-flake-adopt/SKILL.md:84 and skills/nix-diagnose/references/error-catalog.md:65 and :101 are outside this fixer's single editable file and were not changed. The same --inputs-from caveat applies to the nixf-diagnose change at error-catalog.md:65.

168 (findings 3 and 7 merged): neither text was used alone. Finding 7's -e list misses `lockFile = "${finalAttrs.src}/`, which finding 3 and NIX-PKG-15 require, so line 168 now reads `grep -rnE '(readFile|importTOML|importJSON|lockFile =) "\$\{(src|finalAttrs\.src|self)\}/' --include='*.nix' .`. Watched: the red fixture exited 0 with all 5 planted reads (src, finalAttrs.src, self, importTOML, importJSON). The green fixture exited 1 with build-time interpolations and ./Cargo.lock.

254: the SKILL.md item 4 rewrite (lines 392-394) is outside my file. It belongs to /home/mherwig/dev/grimoire-lore/.agents/worktrees/nix/skills/nix-flake-adopt/SKILL.md and is not applied. In this file, findings 1 and 2 overlap. I applied the shared overlay once and used finding 1's prose for the paragraph. The edited fence passes nixfmt --check (exit 0) and deadnix --fail --no-lambda-pattern-names (exit 0).
